seo.title: About ITMAP — Independent AI-Powered Vendor Intelligence
seo.description: Learn about ITMAP's mission to deliver unbiased, real-time enterprise IT vendor intelligence — faster and more transparent than traditional analyst firms.

hero.subtitle: ITMAP was created by enterprise IT practitioners who were tired of paying for research that had already been paid for by the vendors they were supposed to be evaluating.

mission.heading: Giving enterprise buyers the intelligence they deserve
mission.paragraph1: For too long, enterprise technology research has been a product sold to vendors first, and to buyers second.
mission.paragraph2: ITMAP is different. We believe procurement teams, CIOs and IT architects deserve intelligence that is provably unbiased — built on public data, scored by AI, and never for sale to vendors.

items.title: Radical Independence
items.description: We accept zero vendor payments, sponsorships or paid placements. Every score is determined purely by data and methodology.

items.title: Total Transparency
items.description: Every vendor evaluation exposes its sources, criteria and weights. Nothing is hidden. Everything is verifiable.

items.title: Real-Time Precision
items.description: Market intelligence that reflects today — not last quarter. Our AI processes news, releases and signals continuously.

items.title: AI-Native Methodology
items.description: Built from the ground up around large language models — not retrofitted. AI is at the core of every analysis we produce.

team.heading: Practitioners building for practitioners
team.description: ITMAP is built by a team of enterprise IT veterans who've led technology selection projects from both sides of the table — as IT leaders making decisions, and as technologists building the platforms being evaluated.
highlights: 40+ years of combined enterprise IT experience
Former analysts from leading research firms
Deep operational expertise in infrastructure, cloud and data protection
Technologists who've lived the vendor selection challenge firsthand

contact.heading: Let's talk intelligence
contact.description: Whether you're exploring the platform, asking about licensing, or want to discuss your organisation's vendor selection challenges — we'd love to hear from you.
